changeSet.author: bhoward
changeSet.sql: create or alter procedure [utility].[GetFieldTypeLookupList] as begin SELECT 'L' as type, Uid as value, 'Business Asset : ' + Name as title FROM AssetType where [Class] = 1 UNION SELECT 'L' as type, Uid as value, 'Technical Asset : ' + Name as title FROM AssetType where [Class] = 8 UNION SELECT 'L' as type, CAST(CAST(0 AS BINARY) AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER) as value, 'Reference List' as title UNION SELECT 'L' as type, Uid as value, 'Reference List Item: ' + Name as title FROM AssetType where [Object] = 'ReferenceItemType' UNION SELECT 'L' as type, Uid as value, 'Resource : User' as title FROM AssetType where [Class] = 11 UNION SELECT 'L' as type, Uid as value, 'Model : ' + Name as title FROM AssetType where [Object] = 'TaxonomyType' UNION SELECT 'L' as type, CAST(CAST(0 AS BINARY) AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER) as value, 'Model Type' as title end
